Subject: Priming bridge handoff: circuit priming, ACL verification & smoke certification

Team / ACME / NSDC,

We are on the final run toward the private-deploy cutover this weekend. This thread is the single source for the circuit priming and post-cutover smoke certification. Please read and ACK the specific whiteboard items you own. Attachments: priming-checklist.pdf, switch-port-matrix.csv.

Summary of objectives (short):
- Ensure physical circuit and patch mappings match switch-port-matrix.csv
- Apply ACLs listed in priming checklist (section B) and confirm via test-ips
- Run runbook-playback steps 1–6 for KV cache warm-up and prefix priming
- Execute smoke tests (basic generation, KV cache hit, telemetry sanity) within the 2-hour window following cutover

Acceptance criteria (minimal):
- All control-plane egress to Redwood endpoints allowed for 10.3.0.0/22 and 10.5.0.0/24
- RPC latency <= 25ms median for synthetic trace during the smoke window
- No >0.5% 5xx rate on model-serving endpoints during smoke

Please do the following by EOD Thursday 2027-04-29:
- laura_bennett: confirm ACL application + attach iptables/ASA diff (or say N/A)
- irene_choi: runbook playback link + expected KV warmup timeline
- karthik_iyer: telemetry checks and dashboard pre-seed (channels/queries)
- monica_patel: orchestration/autoscale sanity and canary fallback set
- aditya_rao: ownership of cutover bridge two-way comms (bridge host + phone list)

ACME / NSDC: confirm patch panel IDs, cable confirmations, and maintenance window (we plan to start at 02:00 UTC on 2027-05-01). If anything blocks scheduling we need to escalate now.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Private Deploys | Redwood Inference
